description: Task 7 held-out regulatory benchmark. Disjoint from evaluation/retrieval/benchmark_questions.json: no gold section is shared with Task 2's set. Same schema, so evaluation/retrieval/run_benchmark.py::evaluate scores it unchanged. Gold labels are (doc_id, section_number); any one match counts as a hit. Realistic questions also carry a 'paraphrase': the same question in lay developer language avoiding the code's own vocabulary, scored separately to measure how much retrieval depends on matching regulatory terminology.
